title: "YZYCORD" [YouTube Playlist]
description: In October 2023 (and later June 2024) a bunch of unreleased songs were posted to Kanye West's YouTube Music account, in what many people assumed was a hack. These uploads were actually done by the music distributor Too Lost, who represented Ye's rights on YouTube in 2023 (and later distributed VULTURES 2). During October 2023, a large amount of leaks got copyright claimed on YouTube by Too Lost, in what was likely an automated move where they were directly ripped from YouTube uploads since many edits were claimed (including a "Can U Be" edit that had a pause in it to avoid being blocked by a UMG copyright claim). On October 5, 2023, many of these leaks uploaded to the YouTube Content ID system were made public, in what was probably a mistake on Too Lost's part. Many of these, including the "Can U Be" edit, were quickly taken down. Ye then switched to using Label Engine as a distributor for VULTURES 1 and the singles leading up to it. Sometime after VULTURES 1's release, Ye stopped using Label Engine as a distributor and switched back to Too Lost. On June 4, 2024, more songs from the mass copyright claims in October were uploaded to Kanye's YouTube Music, and many of the songs uploaded on October 5 were made public again. As of now 46 of these uploads are still publicly available, and fans have compiled them into a playlist called "YZYCORD" for some reason. Every song on the playlist is either an edit or a song that previously leaked, there's nothing unleaked in there. The playlist linked isn't the one with the most views but it contains all 46 songs, whereas the most popular one is missing a few. Highlights of the playlist include a laughably terrible "Super Starred" edit and the popular Juice WRLD "Future Sounds" edit. Many of these uploads have hundreds of thousands of views on YouTube.
